releaseNotes: Playback reliability — songs no longer skip when a cached track's signed stream URL has expired; Sonora now re-fetches fresh audio from SoundCloud and plays it instead of silently moving on
Frame-accurate real-time seek bar and lyrics — the timeline and word-by-word highlighting stay perfectly locked to the audio at 60fps
Auto-update hardening — the desktop updater now has an explicit GitHub release target baked in, so every install reliably finds and pulls the latest version on launch
Transient update-check errors (network blips, rate limits) stay silent instead of flooding the screen — real errors still surface, once
Desktop installs auto-update to the newest release the moment it's ready, deferring only while a song is playing so your music is never interrupted
